mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by raising discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration that triggers immediate equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market contraction (HOUST < 1300) combined with strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 650000) indicates a shift to services-driven growth, boosting S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
regime_hint: housing downturn with strong consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL reading above 6.0% indicates persistent inflation that prompts aggressive Fed policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 6.0%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 200000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) signal a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
